_meta.protocol: Silver rows keep the live package citations as cited covers pages. The 13 previously unsourced skills are gold13. The seven previously cited CASE skills are verified20; together gold13 plus verified20 are the 20 hand-read CASE skills from verifier v2. For gold13 and verified20, every positive and negative was read by hand, URLs were fetched live, and every adjudicated item carries a DeepSeek third opinion using the VERIFY_V2 prompt. When the third opinion disagreed, the note stays in why and the human label was kept only after rereading the page.
